THE COACH STOP.note: Doc 48 S7: 'The one exit is the coach stop, east.' Beat 3 at the coach stop (coach_stop_dawn, errata 121 B): Thad's last spoken line, then beat 4, the Act IV letter over black (doc 04 Part Three's, as Room 19 reads it). No document writes the stop a LOOK or LISTEN: a stub (errata 72 F). Beat 5's credits are not built (doc 36 Q176). Errata 189: its LOOK and LISTEN are doc 106's (linesFrom), and it is no longer a stub.

obstacles.note: A thing on the ground he must walk around. Thad walked through the trough because the walk bands are full-width quads and nothing in them says otherwise. The rect is the trough’s own hotspot rect -- one truth, not two.

The same dog, at the same place on the same street at dawn (errata 167): walked around, not through. Tyler, 2026-11-07: "He shouldn't be able to walk on or through the dog." The dog lies in the mud at 2628,765 and the bands ran straight through him. The rect is the dog's own hotspot rect, as the trough's is -- one truth, not two -- and the ground behind him stays walkable (keepsGroundAbove): a dog asleep in the street is walked around, front or back.

The hitching rail and its horses (errata 187, moved back by errata 198, moved right and sized by errata 201): a group on the ground he walks around, never through. The rect is the hooves', hay's and posts' footprint, from the drawn group (content/ambient/hitching-horses.json, hooves on 1470,746): errata 198's footprint [1226, 720, 332, 42] in the rest frame's own rows and columns, laid on the group as the engine now draws it (frame left 1278, the hay's foot on 755, 0.549 of a sheet pixel to a room pixel). The ground behind them stays walkable (keepsGroundAbove), as the dog's does, and he passes behind them there.
